name: Dr. Thorup Petersen
role: The driver. Randers physician with a car

known.fact: Drives Hoff and Røjel to reconnoitre; drives the explosives to the plantation on 15 Nov.
known.source: CHARACTERS.md v1 (Straarup, RAHS 2020; research notes; Knud Birk memoir; Randers Kommune info board)

known.fact: Warns Røjel on the morning of 20 Nov that the arrests have begun.
